parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  lead_id: $json.lead_id,
  lead_pipeline_stage_id: $('Normalize booking').first().json.trigger === 'BOOKING_CANCELLED' ? undefined : 16,
  attributes: {
    next_meeting_at:       $('Normalize booking').first().json.trigger === 'BOOKING_CANCELLED' ? '' : $('Normalize booking').first().json.start_time,
    next_meeting_join_url: $('Normalize booking').first().json.trigger === 'BOOKING_CANCELLED' ? '' : $('Normalize booking').first().json.join_url,
    calcom_booking_uid:    $('Normalize booking').first().json.booking_uid,
  },
  activity_title:
    $('Normalize booking').first().json.trigger === 'BOOKING_CANCELLED' ? 'Meeting cancelled' :
    $('Normalize booking').first().json.trigger === 'BOOKING_RESCHEDULED' ? 'Meeting rescheduled' :
    'Meeting booked',
  activity_note:
    'Cal.com booking — ' + $('Normalize booking').first().json.event_title +
    '\n• When: ' + ($('Normalize booking').first().json.start_time || 'unknown') +
    '\n• Join: ' + ($('Normalize booking').first().json.join_url || 'n/a') +
    '\n• UID:  ' + $('Normalize booking').first().json.booking_uid +
    ($('Normalize booking').first().json.notes ? '\n• Notes:\n' + $('Normalize booking').first().json.notes : ''),
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  person: {
    name:    $('Normalize booking').first().json.name,
    email:   $('Normalize booking').first().json.email,
    phone:   $('Normalize booking').first().json.phone || undefined,
    company: $('Normalize booking').first().json.company || undefined,
  },
  lead_pipeline_id: 4,
  lead_pipeline_stage_id: 16,
  lead_source_id: 3,
  lead_type_id: 1,
  title: 'Cal.com booking — ' + $('Normalize booking').first().json.name + ($('Normalize booking').first().json.company ? ' / ' + $('Normalize booking').first().json.company : ''),
  description: $('Normalize booking').first().json.notes || '',
  attributes: {
    next_meeting_at:       $('Normalize booking').first().json.start_time,
    next_meeting_join_url: $('Normalize booking').first().json.join_url,
    calcom_booking_uid:    $('Normalize booking').first().json.booking_uid,
  },
  activity_note:
    'Booked via Cal.com (no prior lead found).' +
    '\n• When: ' + ($('Normalize booking').first().json.start_time || 'unknown') +
    '\n• Join: ' + ($('Normalize booking').first().json.join_url || 'n/a') +
    '\n• Event: ' + $('Normalize booking').first().json.event_title,
}) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, trigger: $('Normalize booking').first().json.trigger, booking_uid: $('Normalize booking').first().json.booking_uid }) }}
